title: I know you
objectives: ask Wh- questions about family members

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for I know you:
ask Wh- questions about family members; describe family relationships in detail
Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: many, tell, nice, close, together
Complete the question: '___ cousins do you have?'
Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Tell me about your family. How many relatives do you have? We are close and live together.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.
Interview your partner about their family size, relatives, and close relationships.
Today you practiced: ask Wh- questions about family members, describe family relationships in detail.
